raw_text: Two Chinese PLA Navy warships have docked at Hambantota Port in southern Sri Lanka for a 5-day goodwill visit. One identified as Type 054A frigate. Sri Lanka Navy says routine port call diplomacy. Indian strategic community concerned about Chinese naval presence at the Chinese-built and operated deep-water port.
